mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 inducer that significantly increases efavirenz metabolism, reducing efavirenz plasma concentrations by 25-35% and potentially compromising antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Increase efavirenz dose to 600 mg daily (standard dose) or consider alternative TB regimen; monitor efavirenz plasma concentrations if available and assess virological response closely.
